Title: Qwen
Description:
QWEN STUDIO DISCORD
Today, we are introducing Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery. Qwen4-Max is built on the new Qwen4 architecture, with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone, native vision capabilities, and a one-million-token context window.
Qwen4-Max advances real-world productivity through greater proficiency with professional tools, stronger long-horizon task execution, and higher-quality deliverables. It can take on a wide range of creative and professional work, spanning 3D modeling, game development, precision manufacturing, finance, law, healthcare, and frontier scientific discovery.

Title: A datetime library for Rust
Description:
Jiff is a datetime library for Rust that encourages you to jump into the
pit of success. Jiff automatically handles many common problems related to
daylight saving time by putting time zone handling front and center into the
API. Jiff has already seen widespread adoption in the Rust ecosystem.
